_what: v3899 #154 (REG-3971, GrokBot on a grok/ branch) - a GEARED figure per class for a MAIN's card: each class's animated in-game sprite wearing armour, not the bare starting outfit tv/data/class_art.json's d2rw_cls_* loops show. Each file was downloaded, opened and read before it entered art/; sha256 pins the bytes that were read. NOT WIRED: bible.html and the console are untouched, Claude wires the card. tv/test_a_main_has_a_geared_figure_per_class.py guards this file.
_why: His 11-08 card #154 (a MAIN should look geared); class_art.json said 'no site serves a geared variant per class (measured 11-08)'. diablo-archive.fandom.com's Diablo II build pages carry in-game GIFs of geared characters for seven of the eight classes.
